p.src: 5  Behold, there was a wall on the outside of the house all around, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed six cubits long, of a cubit and a hand width each. So he measured the thickness of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.

ja: えた長さを一キュビトとする、六キュビト の測り竿があった。
en: Behold, there was a wall on the outside of the house all around, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed six cubits long, of a cubit and a hand width each. So he measured the thickness of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.
u.src: 5  Behold, there was a wall on the outside of the house all around, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed six cubits long, of a cubit and a hand width each. So he measured the thickness of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.

ja: 40:5 通常の一キュビトは、人の腕の中指の先からひじまでの長さで、約18インチ、または46センチメートルである。一手幅は約4.3インチ、または11センチメートルなので、ここで述べられている長キュビトは約22.3インチ、または57センチメートルとなる。したがって、長キュビト六キュビトの測り竿は、約3ヤード26.6インチ、または約3.42メートルであった。
en: 40:5 A normal cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. A handbreadth is about 4.3 inches or 11 centimeters, so the long cubit described here would be about 22.3 inches or 57 centimeters long. Thus, a 6 long cubit measuring reed would have been about 3 yards 26.6 inches or about 3.42 meters long.
